verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM docs claim access is provisioned or revoked based on risk signals and company policy, with dynamic rules for group access. Its device-management docs mention custom security policies built on user and device attributes. This is a thin claim of risk- and attribute-driven access, not documented conditional access at authentication time. Missing for 10: network/IP-based conditions, location/geo conditions, device-posture checks at login, per-app conditional policy configuration, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
